ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-level ratio of approximately 95:5 relative to high-intensity (white/scarring) pixels visible on the fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform solid black pigmentation (Type 1) across the entire visible ventral surface; high-contrast white contiguous clusters are localized specifically at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central convergence point with an estimated pixel angle of 40 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 12 pixels along the trailing boundary, creating a jagged profile isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep trajectory from the central notch toward the distal tips, with a tapering width as the lobes extend laterally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting roughly circular and clustered geometric patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of numerous fine, white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented primarily in horizontal and diagonal directions across both black lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake marks distributed across the ventral surface and dense white clusters (barnacle colonization) at the outer lateral margins of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-density population of pinnipeds (seals/sea lions) in the surrounding background pixel data.
